mods.name: Vast Ores
mods.en: Ten new ores, nine alloys and three gems, with dusts, plates, gears and rods
mods.pt: Dez minérios novos, nove ligas e três gemas, com pós, placas, engrenagens e hastes

mods.name: Vast Depths
mods.en: Stellarite, Infernium and Voidium: end-game metals, tools and armour
mods.pt: Estelarita, Infernium e Voidium: metais, ferramentas e armaduras de fim de jogo

mods.name: Vast Compressed
mods.en: 828 compressed blocks, nine tiers deep, and back
mods.pt: 828 blocos compactados, em nove níveis, e de volta

mods.name: Vast Adventures
mods.en: Loot with rarities and affixes, gems, sockets, bosses and dungeons
mods.pt: Loot com raridades e afixos, gemas, encaixes, chefes e masmorras

mods.name: Vast Spawners
mods.en: Change spawners with items, and mine them with Silk Touch
mods.pt: Mude spawners com itens e minere-os com Toque Suave

mods.name: Vast Enchanting
mods.en: An enchanting table past max levels, its shelves, anvil tomes and book archives
mods.pt: Uma mesa de encantamento além do nível máximo, suas estantes, tomos de bigorna e arquivos de livros

mods.name: Vast Star
mods.en: The last craft: five cores, a Star Seed and the Vast Star
mods.pt: O último craft: cinco núcleos, a Semente Estelar e a Estrela Vasta

mods.name: Vast Tweaks
mods.en: KubeJS-style scripts for recipes and tags, with /reload
mods.pt: Scripts estilo KubeJS para receitas e tags, com /reload

mods.name: Vast Unify
mods.en: Other mods' metals become Vast Ores': one tin, not five
mods.pt: Os metais de outros mods viram os do Vast Ores: um estanho, não cinco

mods.name: Fullscreen Fix
mods.en: Exclusive fullscreen that fills the whole screen on macOS
mods.pt: Tela cheia exclusiva que ocupa a tela inteira no macOS

en: **3D items:** the cores, the star, the gems, the seals and the Ore Hammer get real shapes in the hand, on the ground and in frames (the inventory keeps their sprites).
**Vast Spawners 0.2:** Jade lines for every spawner and a Spawner Modifiers category in Just Enough Items.
More of the family: new mods that Horizon doesn't have yet.
pt: **Itens 3D:** núcleos, estrela, gemas, selos e o Martelo de Minério ganham formas de verdade na mão, no chão e nas molduras (no inventário continuam os sprites).
**Vast Spawners 0.2:** linhas do Jade para cada spawner e uma categoria Modificadores de Spawner no Just Enough Items.
Mais da família: mods novos que o Horizon ainda não tem.
